name: packet_analysis
description: Deep packet capture and analysis: tcpdump + tshark protocol breakdown with credential extraction.
author: james-linux

steps.description: Capture up to 100k packets with tcpdump

params.command: tshark -r /tmp/james_packets.pcap -Y http.request -T fields -e ip.src -e http.host -e http.request.uri 2>/dev/null | head -50

steps.description: Extract HTTP requests with hosts and URIs

params.command: tshark -r /tmp/james_packets.pcap -Y dns.qr==0 -T fields -e ip.src -e dns.qry.name 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head -50

tshark -r /tmp/james_packets.pcap -Y 'http.authbasic or ftp.request.command==PASS or ftp.request.command==USER' -T fields -e ip.src -e ip.dst -e http.authbasic -e ftp.request.arg 2>/dev/null | head -20

steps.description: Extract cleartext credentials (HTTP Basic Auth, FTP)
